name: CODE.BREACH
source:
"Beyond the high walls of London-1, millions fight to survive in the slums. Only one of them dreams of us."

In the year 2096, a young man with troubling dreams scrapes a living in the slums outside the city of London-1. His innate hacking abilities and street-wise experience allow him to complete technician jobs that barely cover his rent. One such job lands him working with the Falcons, a mercenary crew on the hunt for a missing package. What happens next reveals questions about the young man's own past - and everyone else's future.

The story is framed by the Voice, an unseen presence that acts as a link between the player and the protagonist. The Voice is entirely aware of the player, and joins them in the adventure of discovering the protagonist's story.

Where will the young man's journey lead within the dystopian world he occupies? And what will become of his dreams?
